name: BeatSwap LiquidityVestingConvert slot0 spot-price BTX quote
summary: LiquidityVestingConvert and its Once variant paired a deposit's USDT with BTX from their own reserves, sized from the V3 pool's slot0 spot price and checked only against that same quote. With flash loans the attacker crashed the BTX price, deposited 10,000 and 2,000 USDT so both contracts put nearly all their BTX into LP at that price, then bought it back and sold it.
notes: Both contracts are immutable non-proxies with TARGET_POOL and the quote logic fixed; the later setMinDeposit(10000e18) and setFixedDeposit(2000e18) only set deposit sizes, which scale the loss, so deployment is the reset. LiquidityVestingConvert, deployed 124 blocks after its sibling, sets the age.

Loss is the two contracts' BTX reserve that left for the manipulated LP mints. The attacker's dump moved the price, so all of it is valued at its in-transaction sale rate (79,654.84 USDT for 3,067,057.87 BTX), not DefiLlama's /bin/bash.0317. The attacker's deposits, flash loans and round trip are its own inputs.
Campaign: no other deposit into either contract swapped the pool in the same transaction, and the attacker has not withdrawn its vesting entries.
